== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Princess Leia Organa (V) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text (the PC website card list). '''Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text.''' The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB3-79-Princess_Leia_Organa.png]]) and the Master List (2013) show the words of [[Princess Leia Organa (V)]] and the current text.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured 21 July 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html); 11 December 2012 (https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205219/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html); 11 January 2013 (https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142208/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html); also on the Virtual master list (VMasterType) to 11 January 2013. Typos, capitals and punctuation are kept as published; icons the list writes out in words, and its straight quote marks, are drawn as the printed slip draws them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “&#42; Deploys free only as an escorted captive of Jabba or a bounty hunter. Your Strangle destiny draws are +1. "Escort alone" on Strangle is treated as "escort". When released, escort is lost and you may retrieve any three cards (except Strangle).”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, set mark, slip label and copyright line as printed) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>.spec.json</code> next to the image in the batch C2/C3 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
